fb-2.summary: OpenAI adjusted token pricing for GPT-4o-mini, making high-volume classification and summarization more cost-effective for enterprise automations.

fb-3.title: GitHub Copilot expands agent mode for multi-file repository edits
fb-3.summary: Copilot's agent mode now supports broader repository context and task planning, positioning it closer to IDE-native autonomous coding assistants.

fb-4.summary: CFOs and platform teams are adopting unified AI cost dashboards to align tool adoption with measurable ROI and seat utilization targets.

fb-5.summary: Gemini Flash emphasizes speed and cost for agentic pipelines, with competitive per-million-token rates for high-throughput applications.

fb-7.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot seat bundles shift to usage-based add-ons
fb-7.summary: Microsoft is piloting flexible Copilot licensing tied to active users rather than flat per-seat bundles for large enterprises.
